items.question: What daily and weekly report times, quiet hours, and reminder caps should the first owner use?
items.impact: Blocks final reminder configuration but not the review-queue contract.

items.question: What is the first real dogfood learning topic and approved source set?
items.impact: Blocks end-to-end behavioral acceptance and realistic fixtures.

items.question: What mastery thresholds should each knowledge type use?
Which reminder-delivery adapter ships first?
items.impact: The review queue can be built, but out-of-session delivery acceptance remains blocked.

items.question: What versioned state schemas and implementation language should v0.1 use?
items.impact: Blocks implementation, migrations, and a portable test command.

items.question: Should each upstream skill be vendored, installed as a peer, or invoked through runtime discovery?
items.impact: Blocks packaging design; complete capability and provenance integration remain required.

items.question: When should the repository become public?
items.impact: Repository visibility determines whether the GitHub Free organization can enforce main-branch protection.
items.resolution: Made public on 2026-07-26 after a tracked-file credential-pattern scan so GitHub Free could enforce PR-only protected main.
